Spherical Antigravity Flying Craft - United Kingdom patent

#ufotwitter

The patent describes a spherical (globe-shaped) craft with a polished aluminum shell designed for anti-gravity propulsion and faster-than-light travel. 

It claims to overcome the relativistic mass increase that limits conventional rocket propulsion (as per Einstein's theories), allowing the craft to carry payloads without those speed constraints.

 Key proposed mechanism:

The outer aluminum shell is electrically charged.

A static DC generator, diodes, and isolating condensers create a flow of ions that exit from the top of the craft and enter at the bottom.

Spiral linear drive magnetic coils (wired to a variable high-frequency, low-amperage generator) oscillate these ions.

A high-frequency carrier wave is modulated by this oscillation to "bend the gravity wave around the craft", causing it to "float free" (anti-gravity effect).

Propulsion comes from increasing the frequency to the coils, enabling linear action on gravity waves for extremely high speeds — claimed to be many times faster than light.

The design emphasizes simplicity: one entrance (top or bottom only), a control panel, floor, and optional electric motors. Takeoff requires the craft to be "completely isolated," which the inventor notes as the main practical limit on size. It's positioned as a cheap, low-pollution alternative for launching satellites.

The patent has essentially one independent claim, which is quite broad and explanatory rather than narrowly technical. It states that the craft bends exterior forces (gravity waves) around itself using modulated ions on the surface, avoiding rocket limitations and enabling superluminal travel.

Technical Details from the Description

Shell (S): Polished aluminum, all seams/welds smooth.

Coils (W): Spiral from top to bottom inside the shell.

Power: High-frequency generator (M) for coils + static DC generator with diodes (D) and condensers (C).

Access: Single entrance (A), with top/bottom plates (T/B).

Operation: Charge surface → oscillate ions top-to-bottom → modulate wave → bend gravity → float + drive.

This is an unconventional propulsion patent falling under classifications for cosmonautic vehicles and "unconventional spacecraft propulsion systems."
